resources.string: Automated SMS Analysis

These notifications pertain to the automated analysis of SMS messages. When an SMS is received, the app notifies the user to decide whether to analyze it. If the user agrees, the analysis begins, and subsequent updates are reflected in the notification.
New SMS received
